# EconStor

> EconStor is an economic research repository protected by advanced bot-detection and anti-scraping security mechanisms.

EconStor provides access to economic research and scholarly content with multi-layered security protections. The platform uses Anubis bot-protection powered by Hashcash Proof-of-Work challenges and JShelter JavaScript security to verify legitimate human access while preventing automated scraping and unauthorized bot access.

## Key Topics

- Anubis bot-protection
- Hashcash Proof-of-Work
- JShelter
- JavaScript challenge
- Anti-scraping
- Server security
- Access verification
- Bot detection
- TecharoHQ
- Challenge page

## Security & Access

- [EconStor Homepage](https://www.econstor.eu/): Main entry point to EconStor with Anubis bot-protection using Hashcash Proof-of-Work verification to ensure human access
- [Locale-Specific Access Verification](https://www.econstor.eu/.;?&locale=en): Language-specific gateway with Anubis security challenge for verified access to EconStor content
